title: Twenty seconds at a time
caption: Cuts from Racing Desk recordings on the rig, 720p, each from a 0.5–2.4 GB MP4 with a telemetry sidecar beside it.

files.caption: Seven AI cars on the Lake Murray race layout (v0.17) under an overcast sky, recorded the day the three layouts were installed.
The race corridor from the seat: an Alvarado-wide lane per direction, open turn boxes.
Road Atlanta, Ligier JS P320: the Racing Desk in-car HUD over a live iRacing session, face cam in the corner.
Mount Panorama, Porsche 911 Cup: the glance layout over a race.
